title: Raining Cats and Dogs
intro: Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy! [excited] It's raining cats and dogs today, and I'm not talking about the weather. Every category is about the furry friends of Disney. Get ready to roll over, sit and stay... [laughs] for some trivia.

art.prompt: A cozy storybook London street on a rainy evening, umbrellas floating down like raindrops, a red front door with a dog bowl and a cat basket, paw prints of all sizes splashing through the puddles, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Spot the Answer
categories.intro: Our film category has a whole lot of spots. [gasps] Ninety-nine puppies' worth! It's One Hundred and One Dalmatians.

art.prompt: A stylish 1960s London flat with a piano and sheet music by the window, a fireplace, a bright red sports car outside and dozens of tiny black-and-white spotted dog collars hanging on hooks, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Cruella De Vil wants the puppies' spotted fur to make one of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a coat! If she doesn't scare you, no evil thing will. [sarcastic] Fashion crimes, literally.

clues.clue: Pongo's human, a songwriter, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Roger Radcliffe! Pongo basically set him up with Anita in the park. [laughs] Best wingman EVER.

clues.clue: The dogs of London pass along news of the missing puppies through this nighttime barking network.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Twilight Bark! [chuckles] Doggy group chat, 1961 style. No phones, just lungs.

clues.clue: Pongo and Perdita's own litter has this many puppies.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is fifteen! Add the eighty-four puppies they rescue, plus Mom and Dad, and you get... [dramatic pause] one hundred and one!

clues.clue: This brave cat helps the Colonel and Captain free the puppies from the old De Vil mansion.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sergeant Tibbs! A cat saving ninety-nine dogs. [laughs] The internet's cat people have been bragging about it ever since.

categories.title: The Cat-egory
categories.intro: Next up, you guessed it... [chuckles] the CAT-egory! I'll describe a famous Disney feline. You name it.

art.prompt: An elegant Paris rooftop at night with jazz instruments, a velvet cushion, a ball of yarn, a fishbone and glowing cat-eye shaped stars in the sky, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In The Aristocats, she's the elegant white mother of Marie, Berlioz and Toulouse.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Duchess! Classy, kind and voiced by Eva Gabor. [excited] Everybody wants to be her.

clues.clue: Cinderella's lazy, mean-spirited cat, who's always after the mice.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lucifer! Animator Ward Kimball modeled him partly on his own chubby cat. [mischievously] Hopefully that cat was nicer.

clues.clue: Geppetto's little black and white kitten in Pinocchio.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Figaro! Walt loved him so much, he later became Minnie Mouse's pet. [laughs] Big promotion.

clues.clue: In 2008's Bolt, this streetwise alley cat teaches Bolt how to be a real dog.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mittens! She taught a super dog how to beg, chase sticks and stick his head out the car window. ICONIC mentor.

clues.clue: Finish this alley cat's name from The Aristocats: Abraham de Lacy Giuseppe Casey Thomas ...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is O'Malley! Thomas O'Malley, the alley cat. [laughs] Try putting all that on a name tag.

categories.title: Paws for a Close-Up
categories.intro: It's the zoom category! I'll show you a picture of a scene from a Disney film about cats or dogs, zoomed way, way in. It'll slowly zoom out. [excited] Buzz in when you know the movie.

art.prompt: A vintage camera lens zooming in on a cozy dog bed and a cat's basket, paw-print shaped bokeh lights and a magnifying glass resting on a pile of pet toys, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Which classic Disney dog movie is this romantic scene from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lady and the Tramp! One plate of spaghetti, one moonlit alley, and the most famous meatball nudge in history. [sighs]

media.prompt: Painterly storybook illustration of a single plate of spaghetti and meatballs on a red-and-white checkered tablecloth in a moonlit cobblestone back alley behind an Italian restaurant, a candle in a straw-wrapped bottle, an accordion resting on a wooden crate, warm golden light, no people, no animals, no text

clues.clue: Which Disney film about a dog who thinks he's a superhero is this scene from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bolt! That hamster ball belongs to Rhino, the most confident hamster in the world. [laughs] Total awesomeness!

media.prompt: Cinematic digital painting of a clear plastic hamster ball rolling alone down an empty desert highway at sunset, a glowing white lightning-bolt shape painted on a dusty road sign, a Hollywood film soundstage visible in the far distance, no people, no animals, no text

clues.clue: Which Disney film set in New York City is this scene from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Oliver and Company! 1988, New York City, and a kitten who joins a gang of dogs. [chuckles] Why should he worry?

media.prompt: Rainy 1980s New York City street at night illustrated in a gritty hand-painted animation style, a steaming hot dog cart under a striped umbrella, a cardboard box marked with nothing on the wet sidewalk, yellow taxi headlights reflecting in puddles, a barge docked at a pier in the background, no people, no animals, no text, no logos

clues.clue: Which Disney film set in Paris is this scene from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Aristocats! Those bowls hold creme de la creme a la Edgar, laced with sleeping pills. [mischievously] Never trust a butler with a whisk.

media.prompt: Elegant 1910 Paris townhouse parlor illustrated in loose watercolor and ink, a grand piano with sheet music, a velvet cushion, a silver tray holding four small porcelain bowls of cream, tall windows looking out to Parisian rooftops and the Eiffel Tower, no people, no animals, no text

clues.clue: Which Disney film about an unlikely friendship is this scene from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Fox and the Hound! A hunting horn, a farm fence and a friendship that was never supposed to happen. [sighs] Pass the tissues.

media.prompt: Autumn countryside farm illustrated in soft painterly 1980s storybook style, a weathered wooden fence beside a red barn, a brass hunting horn hanging on a fence post, a rustic dog barrel kennel with a rope, golden leaves and a winding creek, no people, no animals, no text

categories.title: Pets at the Parks
categories.intro: Our Parks category is all about the four-legged friends of the Disney parks. Some are costumed, some are animatronic, and some are very, VERY real.

art.prompt: A theme park Main Street at dawn with a water bowl outside a shop, a ring of jail keys on a stone floor, a camping cabin by a lake and a lantern in a misty graveyard, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Mickey's loyal orange pup, who greets guests in the parks without saying a word.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pluto! And yes, Goofy is also a dog. [laughs] Please do not ask me to explain it. I've tried. I can't.

clues.clue: Disneyland is famous for a colony of these furry critters who roam the park at night keeping rodents away.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is cats! Disneyland's cat colony works the night shift. [whispers] Mickey is the only mouse allowed in that park.

clues.clue: In Pirates of the Caribbean, jailed pirates try to coax this animal into handing over the cell keys.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a dog! He's held those keys in his mouth for decades. [chuckles] Talk about job security.

clues.clue: Dogs are welcome at this rustic Walt Disney World campground resort on the shores of Bay Lake.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Fort Wilderness Resort and Campground! Pups can camp out too. S'mores not included for the dog. [laughs]

clues.clue: In the Haunted Mansion graveyard, the frightened caretaker clutches his lantern beside this shivering companion.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is his dog! Scrawny, terrified, and honestly... the most relatable character in the whole Mansion.

categories.title: Who Let the Dogs Out?
categories.intro: [excited] And the fan category goes to the dogs! I'll describe a famous Disney or Pixar pup, you tell me its name.

art.prompt: An open backyard gate with a burst of colorful dog toys flying out: a tennis ball, a squeaky bone, a slinky spring, a talking collar and a frisbee, under a bright blue sky, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Up, this golden retriever with a talking collar says he just met you, and he loves you.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dug! He was hiding under your porch because he loves you. [gasps] SQUIRREL!

clues.clue: In Toy Story, the stretchy dachshund toy with a coil for a middle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Slinky Dog! Buster is Andy's real dog, and Bullseye is a horse. [laughs] Nice try.

clues.clue: Miguel's goofy, hairless Xolo dog in Coco.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dante! The Xolo is the national dog of Mexico. Pepita is the winged spirit guide cat.

clues.clue: Prince Eric's big, shaggy sheepdog in The Little Mermaid.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Max! He knows Ariel's scent before Eric does. [chuckles] Smartest one in the castle.

clues.clue: In 2012's Frankenweenie, young Victor brings this beloved bull terrier back to life with lightning.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sparky! Tim Burton first made this story as a live-action Disney short back in 1984. [dramatic pause] It's ALIVE!
